reason_for_closure: Real raw SWEPOS GNSS observation files for 2024 (ABIS station) are absent from the workspace. Reacquisition requires external user authentication (Lantmateriet/E-GVAP portals). Furthermore, static RINEX/COST-716 archives record observation time t_obs but lack t_pub publication latency logs required to prove strict causality before benchmark t0 = 00:00 UTC. Under the strict POLARIS data rule prohibiting synthetic GNSS generation or hardcoded metric literals, the route cannot satisfy causal real-data requirements and is formally CLOSED as infeasible.
